summary: Toni 合并了 EIP-8131 和 EIP-8279 的 Glamsterdam 对齐更新：EIP-7702 授权按最大编码 133 字节计入交易底价，90 天 1.68 亿笔主网交易中只有 0.66% 会多付（全部是 blob 或 type-4 交易）；Łukasz 关闭了三个为 EIP-2780 和 EIP-8141 补 state gas 规则的 PR。PQ 交易签名方面，EIPsInsight 补充了 PQTS #17 纪要：按 2^24 的签名寿命，Circle 约每 1.5 年需要轮换一次密钥，Ledger 在更高寿命下性能吃紧。一份面向 agent 账户的“策略可读”ERC 草案进入 ERCs 仓库，首条评审就指出了策略放宽可绕过延迟的问题。

items.topic: PQ 账户签名：签名寿命、密钥轮换和“pqai”标签之争
items.title: gballet
items.note: X 上的讨论：gballet 2026-11-21 15:17 认为“pqai”是个危险的标签，抗量子不等于抗 AI，二者可能要取舍；donnoh 15:35 表示赞同并在写文章。Dankrad 16:18 回应：选非常保守的 PQ 方案也更可能扛住 AI 密码分析，还可以叠加，比如用 SPHINCS 的同时仍要求一个椭圆曲线签名，安全性严格提高；他 16:43 补充没有方案能被证明不可破，哈希签名也依赖具体哈希函数，而加一个 EC 签名几乎没有成本。barnabé 22:59 表示 pqai 并不排斥双签名方案。
items.note_en: On X, gballet argued on 2026-11-21 at 15:17 that "pqai" is a dangerous label: quantum security does not imply AI security, and the two may involve a trade-off. donnoh agreed at 15:35 and said he is writing a post. Dankrad replied at 16:18 that a very conservative PQ scheme is also more likely to survive AI cryptanalysis, and that schemes can be stacked, for example SPHINCS plus a required EC signature, which strictly increases security. He added at 16:43 that nothing can be proven unbreakable, hash-based schemes still rely on a specific hash function, and adding an EC signature costs almost nothing. barnabé said at 22:59 that pqai does not rule out a dual-signature scheme.
items.topic_en: PQ account signatures: signature lifetime, key rotation and the "pqai" label

items.title: Zealynx 的评审
items.note: 2026-11-22 06:08 指出：activate 接受任何更高版本并立即生效，注册表只看到哈希，分不清收紧还是放宽，延迟机制形同虚设；验证收据时不检查当前策略版本和 isStopped，也不记录 decisionId，同一收据可重复使用；Safe 的 call 和 delegatecall 得到相同的 intentHash，意图里应加入 operation 或 ERC-7579 执行模式。
items.note_en: On 2026-11-22 at 06:08 pointed out that activate accepts any higher version and applies it immediately, and since the registry only sees a hash it cannot tell a tightening from a loosening, so the delay is only as good as the publisher. Receipt verification does not check the current policy version or isStopped and does not remember decisionId, so a receipt can be reused. For Safes, call and delegatecall produce the same intentHash, so the intent should include the operation or the ERC-7579 execution mode.
items.topic_en: Agent accounts and privacy: readable policies, measurable linkability

items.title: Pre-ERC：Agent Linkability Report
items.note: 2026-11-21 15:03（ERCs PR #2193）提出一种报告格式，说明从公开链上数据能把 ERC-8004 agent 的所有者、agentWallet、收款地址关联到什么程度；每个字段要么附证据，要么注明未读取的原因。作者 11-21 读取 Robinhood Chain 身份注册表，26,235 个 agent 里有 25,620 个没有独立于所有者的 agentWallet，付款直接落到所有者地址。
items.note_en: On 2026-11-21 at 15:03 (ERCs PR #2193) proposes a report format describing how far public chain data can link an ERC-8004 agent's owner, agentWallet and payment address. Every field either carries evidence or states why it was not read. Reading the Robinhood Chain identity registry on 11-21, the author found that 25,620 of 26,235 agents have no agentWallet separate from the owner, so payments land on the owner's own address.
items.topic_en: Agent accounts and privacy: readable policies, measurable linkability

items.title: pcaversaccio
items.note: FHE 隐私争议：上期以太坊官方账号发布 Zama 客座长帖后，围绕 Zama 的讨论继续。pcaversaccio 2026-11-21 16:48 批评这是“依赖厂商的隐私”，代码许可不授予专利权，商业部署需要 Zama 许可；donnoh 21:50 认为很多情况下能用线性运算推出准确金额或很窄的范围，之后的交易还可能回溯泄露隐私。
items.note_en: The FHE privacy debate: after the official Ethereum account published Zama's guest thread last issue, the discussion around Zama continued. pcaversaccio criticised it on 2026-11-21 at 16:48 as "vendor-dependent privacy", since the code licence grants no patent rights and commercial deployments need Zama's permission. donnoh said at 21:50 that in many cases exact amounts or tight bounds can be derived with linear math, and later transactions can leak privacy retroactively.

items.title: EIP-7805（FOCIL）区块大小 bug
items.note: 2026-11-21 16:23：chfast 指出执行层规范没考虑 EIP-7934 的区块 RLP 大小上限，交易“可包含”但加入后区块无效；原型修复是 execution-specs PR #4041，他主张改为只限制区块的交易部分。另外 EIP-7805 rebase PR #12470 11-22 02:10 更新，等待 soispoke 再审。影响：FOCIL 是否进 Hegotá 仍待 ACDC 决定，这类规范问题会影响时间表。
items.note_en: 2026-11-21 16:23: chfast noted the execution layer spec ignores the EIP-7934 block RLP size cap, so a transaction can be "includable" yet make the block invalid. A prototype fix is execution-specs PR #4041, and he argues for capping only the transaction part of the block. Separately, EIP-7805 rebase PR #12470 was updated at 11-22 02:10 and awaits another review from soispoke. Impact: whether FOCIL makes Hegotá is still up to ACDC, and spec issues like this affect the timeline.

items.note_en: 2026-11-22 04:16: a proposal for a narrowly scoped recovery mechanism for proxy wallets hit by the 2017 Parity library destruction. It found 284 candidate proxies, 93 of which held ETH at the historical snapshot, totalling 443,163 ETH (the author stresses this is not a recoverable amount). State intervention proposals like this have always been highly contentious, and this is only a pre-draft.

summary_en: Toni merged updates aligning EIP-8131 and EIP-8279 with Glamsterdam. EIP-7702 authorizations now count toward the transaction floor at their largest encoding of 133 bytes, and across 168M mainnet transactions over 90 days only 0.66% would pay more, all of them blob or type-4 transactions. Łukasz closed three PRs that tried to add state gas rules to EIP-2780 and EIP-8141. On PQ transaction signatures, EIPsInsight added notes from PQTS #17: at a 2^24 signature lifetime, Circle would need to rotate keys roughly every 1.5 years, and Ledger struggles at higher lifetimes. A draft ERC that makes agent account policies readable landed in the ERCs repo, and the first review already found that a policy loosening can skip the delay.
